crossRefs.note: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the…
Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
For whoever finds me, finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.
He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life…
For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good…
He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.
“Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.
He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.
that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with…
I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of…
“But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t…
If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this…
Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.

translations.web: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
translations.bsb: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.
translations.kjv: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
translations.asv: For, He that would love life, And see good days, Let him refrain his tongue from evil, And his lips that they speak no guile:
